decisions.subject: Name and destination
decisions.decision: SMPL Tones; public smpl-works/SMPL-Tones repository; documentation and roadmap issues, no Project board.

decisions.subject: Current deliverable
decisions.decision: Research dossier and future development specification only. No working application or installer is claimed.

decisions.subject: Platform
decisions.decision: Windows 11 x64; full native desktop editor; no initial Android or VST3 product.

decisions.subject: Self-sufficiency
decisions.decision: One complete offline installer; no separately installed music app, Python, account, first-use download or external AI.

decisions.subject: Editing
decisions.decision: Integrate a separately branded stable MuseScore-derived editor, rather than opening another application.

decisions.subject: Stable base
decisions.decision: MuseScore v4.7.6, commit 96480d58445e3b24b230a3fe7d4725d639aa2eb3; the previously reviewed main branch was unstable 5.0.

decisions.subject: Application license
decisions.decision: GPL-3.0-only application direction. All original dossier material is published under the same license; references retain their own terms.

decisions.subject: Model policy
decisions.decision: Required bundled model terms must permit commercial use. Attribution and redistribution obligations still apply.

decisions.subject: MuScriptor decision change
decisions.decision: Earlier leading workflow candidate; now excluded from the required bundle because official weights are CC BY-NC 4.0. NeuralNote v2 uses that same model family.

decisions.subject: Default engine
decisions.decision: YourMT3+ YPTF+Multi (PS) selected subject to provenance, licensing and native-export feasibility gates. Original MT3 checkpoint licensing remains distinct.

decisions.subject: Feature scope
decisions.decision: Complete modern music workflow, not every historical format or research/model option.

decisions.subject: Speed
decisions.decision: Balanced default; fast draft and slower detailed processing. Resource and speed budgets are unmeasured engineering targets.

decisions.subject: Reprocessing
decisions.decision: Keep raw recognition separate from manual score edits; retranscription produces reviewable alternatives.

decisions.subject: Preservation
decisions.decision: Do not delete local investigation folders automatically. Verify published archive before the user considers removing them.
